eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Delhi (NCT) resident with valid Delhi residence proof; Haryana/UP NCR excluded.
eligibility_criteria.age_range: Entry-level school admission (Nursery / KG / Class I: typically 3–7 years [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION])
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: EWS below Delhi EWS ceiling; DG / CWSN per DoE norms [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: EWS, DG (SC/ST/OBC-NCL Delhi list/orphan/transgender), or CWSN.
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: Allotment through DoE computerised lottery draw.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Children outside entry-level age band or without Delhi NCT residence proof.

benefit.summary_hi: निजी गैर-सहायता प्राप्त स्कूलों में 25% आरक्षित सीटों पर 100% मुफ्त शिक्षा, किताबें और वर्दी।
benefit.summary_en: 100% free tuition + free textbooks/notebooks/uniform up to Class VIII (and per DoE norms [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]) under 25% quota.

benefit_summary.en: 100% free tuition + free textbooks/notebooks/uniform up to Class VIII (and per DoE norms [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]) under 25% quota.
benefit_summary.hi: निजी गैर-सहायता प्राप्त स्कूलों में 25% आरक्षित सीटों पर 100% मुफ्त शिक्षा, किताबें और वर्दी।

documents_required: EWS Income Certificate / Caste Certificate / CWSN Disability Certificate

application_steps.online: Apply online via edudel.nic.in during admission cycle.
application_steps.offline: DoE Zonal helpdesk or CFC facilitation.

verification_note.hi: नोट ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): वर्तमान 2026–27 सक्रिय आवेदन विंडो, स्लैब व अंतिम नियम कृपया आधिकारिक सरकारी पोर्टल पर सत्यापित करें।
verification_note.en: Notice ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): Always verify active 2026–27 window, exact slab/amount, and current circular on the official portal before applying.

anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: सरकारी CFC या CSC केंद्र पर केवल निर्धारित सेवा शुल्क (₹0–₹50) व पक्की रसीद लागू
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Nominal authorized CFC/CSC facilitation fee only (always take printed receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
